acceptance_criteria: While listening, the camera stops and the view closes after RECOGNISE_IDLE_MS without a hand seen; a hand seen restarts the wait
A tile tap that cannot be spoken (no local German voice, or the voice fails) shows a line saying so; the tile stays
A camera switch while listening keeps the stacked tiles and their guard

Each frame is converted once (sided frames kept with the buffer); the 'zu lang' line goes when the hands have left the picture; hiding the page, pagehide, a hidden board region and dispose stop the camera while listening (tested)
goal: The continuous gesture view stops the camera when nobody uses it, says when a tile cannot speak, keeps the tiles on a camera switch, does less work per frame, and its camera stops are tested while listening.
